remarks:
Welcome to 98 Wildflower, a well-maintained loft-style condo offering a combination of location, views, convenience, and turn-key ownership in the heart of Ellicottville. Ideally positioned toward the front of the Wildflower complex, this unit enjoys picturesque views toward the Holiday Valley slopes and is within easy walking distance of both the Village of Ellicottville and Holiday Valley Resort. This sought-after unit offers convenient first-floor access with a ground-level patio—perfect for enjoying your morning coffee, relaxing after a day on the slopes, or taking in the surrounding scenery. HOA-provided snow removal includes shoveling the sidewalk all the way to your door, and a complimentary ski-season shuttle provides convenient transportation to Holiday Valley.

Inside, the open-concept layout creates a comfortable and inviting space for relaxing or entertaining, with a loft-style bedroom adding character and additional sleeping space. The living area is centered around a gas fireplace insert, converted from the original fireplace in 2019, providing a cozy gathering space and supplemental heat in addition to the electric baseboard system. Recent improvements include new laminate wood-plank flooring and fresh paint throughout in 2022, as well as a new hot water tank in 2024.

Offered fully furnished and turn-key, the sale includes the furnishings and décor shown, along with kitchen appliances, cookware, dishes, glassware, silverware, small appliances, linens, towels, bedding, and more. Simply bring your personal belongings and start enjoying everything Ellicottville has to offer.

Whether you're looking for a personal mountain getaway, a full-time residence, or an investment property with excellent rental potential, this Wildflower condo is an outstanding opportunity. Enjoy easy access to skiing, snowboarding, golf, hiking, mountain biking, dining, shopping, festivals, and year-round events. With its prime position within the complex, desirable ground-level access, slope views, thoughtful updates, complimentary ski shuttle, and fully furnished turn-key offering, 98 Wildflower is ready to be enjoyed from day one.
